One of everything

Every block in this lesson is wrong in exactly one way, and the way it is wrong is named in the test beside it. A block that trips a second check by accident fails that test, which is how this file stays a specimen rather than becoming a pile.

Inline code can lose a value to the parser, leaving --parent with nothing after it.

See the `example` page for background.

Run example-tool login --org example.com before anything else.

$ example-tool show config

$ example-tool greet ‘world’
FROM registry.example.com/base:latest
RUN example-tool install
$ example-tool auth pull-token --name one --parent  --ttl 30m
$ example-tool iam identity create --username ""
$ example-tool iam binding create --github-repo='/.*'
$ example-tool iam role create
Creating role "demo" under location .
You are about to bind identity "" to that role.
jobs:
  build:
    identity: 

$ fetch https://packages.example.com/APKINDEX.tar.gz
